text_block_list.text:
North Flight's training was progressing 
smoothly for the most part. Since the 
environment was different, I proceeded 
cautiously to see how she'd adjust, but—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Trainer, it's almost time...!

North Flight's physical condition and mood 
both seem flawless. In that case—
choice_data_list: Alright, let's ramp up the load!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: !! Yes!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'm ready for training that will help me 
grow a lot, please treat me well!
choice_data_list: (She's so excited...)

text_block_list.text:
Since we're starting now, I want to begin 
with a catchy training session that will 
get North Flight's spirits soaring even 
higher.
choice_data_list: Let's lift this decorative rock!
A long swim in the cobalt blue sea!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Oh! By decorative rocks, you mean――

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Wah...! What a pretty striped pattern!

What I showed North Flight was a giant, 
beautifully stratified rock formation that 
becomes a hot topic among Umamusume every 
year.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"It really is super decorative! I bet it'd 
go great with a sheer skirt♪"

After checking with the other Umamusume, 
it seems like the ideal load for someone 
entering a growth phase. It should be just 
right for North Flight as she is now.
choice_data_list:
Apparently being able to lift this means 
you're all grown up.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if that's the case... there's nothing 
to do but take on the challenge!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please take a photo for me!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Phewww...gh!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
D-Did you get the shot...? Of me, looking 
like a full-fledged racer...!
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's perfect!
Yeah, you're all set!

text_block_list.text:
I captured North Flight lifting the rock 
on video. Thinking that next year, she'd 
probably be lifting it with even greater 
ease—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"When you say long-distance swimming... 
You mean all the way to that islet over 
there?"

Out where she pointed, an isolated islet 
floated on the water. It was a popular 
spot where growing Umamusume often 
competed to reach, known for building 
tenacity.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Actually... I've always admired it a 
little. Are you really sure it's okay for 
me to try?
choice_data_list:
Let's go for it! I'll support you from the 
boat.

Let's go for it! I'll support you from the 
boat.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes! Please!

"And so North Flight started swimming. At 
first she was making smooth progress, but 
gradually, perhaps running out of stamina, 
she began to slow down."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Haa... oof... gh!

Just a little further to the small island. 
I try to think of encouraging words to 
help her muster her final burst of 
strength. Racking my brain frantically for 
a fashion metaphor—
choice_data_list: Yeah, the sea is a cobalt blue... dress!
Yeah, the sea is a cobalt blue... dress!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...! ...All right! Haaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... I did it!
choice_data_list: You swam the whole way! Well done!
You swam the whole way! Great job!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to Trainer's wonderful 
cheering.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If the sea is a dress, then the waves are 
its drapes... Knowing I was wearing 
something so beautiful filled me with 
strength!
choice_data_list: (Whew...)

text_block_list.text:
North Flight persevered and swam to the 
very end. She took a boat back safely, 
returning near the training camp.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Mmm... So refreshing!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"There are more training options available 
now too, so our medium-distance outfit 
should turn out lovely♪"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ah-wa-wa-wa-wa-wa-waaaah!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-chan?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ah, wha-wha-wha! Wha-wha-wha-wha!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...For now, want to grab some shaved ice 
to cool off?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: *whine...*

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
How about that? Did it help you calm down 
a little?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bzzz... Baa... koo. Baku... shin... 
Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"I can't take it anymore! The Bakushin is 
overflowing...! I can't keep it a secret 
any longer!!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-chan?
choice_data_list: I'm worried... Should we go after them?
I'm worried... Should we go after her?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

Chasing after Sakura Bakushin O... I found 
her running on the training camp's track. 
Watching her run—
—I was lost for words.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaahhh!! Bakushinshiiiiiiin!!!!
choice_data_list: (She's faster than before...!)

text_block_list.text:
Fierce, overwhelming... Her speed, already 
magnificent, had been honed to an even 
sharper edge.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to make a massive explosion... 
no, a massive Bakushin this fall! —Armed 
with my secret weapon!!

What kind of secret weapon had made her so 
much stronger...? When I couldn't help 
asking her upon her return—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply! It's bakushin after a 
controlled bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, I simply left everything to 
Bakushin and just Bakushin-ed, but now 
I'll, you know, snap it into place like 
this!
choice_data_list: (Hmm... definitely the intuitive type!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In last year's Sprinters Stakes, I 
suffered a defeat unbecoming of a class 
representative.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As the class representative... I must 
always remain at the forefront of speed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Which is why! I won't let anyone else 
take the title of the Model of Speed!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
“—Because the exemplary strongest is none 
other than me... Bakushin O!”

Watching Sakura Bakushin O run, North 
Flight was lost in thought for a while. 
And then...—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Is it really okay for me... to stay the 
way I am?
choice_data_list: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I'm just happy to be able to 
give it my all... That's all."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Still... Bakushin O-chan is already way 
ahead of that.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Even though I want to compete with her... 
is it really okay to take a gamble on the 
Shuka Sho?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps I should return to my best 
coordination and master the sprint 
division."

I can understand why North Flight feels 
anxious. That was how intense Sakura 
Bakushin O's evolution was. However...――
choice_data_list:
Why don't we think about it while taking a 
breather?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: —Whoa! The shopping area is so lively.
choice_data_list: Can I pick out your outfit?
Can I pick out an outfit for you?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ! Trainer... did that?
choice_data_list:
I wanted to try something different from 
usual.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "That sounds fun! Please, let's do it!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, what a lovely tank top! Such a 
summery vitamin color, and with that edgy 
cut... It's so cute♪
choice_data_list:
I thought it was a style I don't usually 
see you wear in your casual clothes.

It's just a style I don't see you wear 
very often.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
That's true! Incorporating elements of it 
is one thing, but going full-body sporty 
might be pretty rare.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
In other words, today's theme is... "A 
different side of me"?
choice_data_list: 'Cause it's summer!
It's because it's summer!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right! Alright, I'm going to 
go try it on!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
How do I look? I went with shorts for a 
healthy, sporty vibe!
choice_data_list: It looks really good on you!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yay♪ Please pick out my next outfit too, 
then!

And so, North Flight and I enjoyed fashion 
to our hearts' content—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... I tried on so many clothes♪
choice_data_list: So, how was my outfit?
How did you like my outfit?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
That was wonderful! Trainer's choice was 
so refreshing.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I can discover new sides of myself that I 
never knew about, or return to the style 
I've always loved.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Going on an adventure is so much fun, 
isn't it—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. Could it be...
choice_data_list: Let's be fearless and go on an adventure!

text_block_list.text:
Challenging middle distance won't leave 
you falling behind. There will definitely 
be things to gain that can be applied to 
the sprint route. Besides—
choice_data_list:
A career in racing is a truly precious 
thing.

text_block_list.text:
One's prime doesn't last very long. There 
are races you can only challenge once in 
your life. Being North Flight, you of all 
people should understand just how 
irreplaceable that is.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...'Just like fashion, enjoy the race 
too.'

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... You told me that before, didn't 
you?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Is it really alright? For me to do 
everything I want to do?
choice_data_list: Because you did, you're here today.
Because you did, you're here today.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Because I didn't give up... 
right now, I—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. I... won't hesitate 
anymore.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'll wear a medium-distance outfit. I'll 
beat Bakushin O-chan, too... I won't give 
up on anything.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to enjoy all of it! My one and 
only—racing career!
